Question: The symbolism \(\lfloor x \rfloor\) denotes the largest integer not exceeding \(x.\) For example, \(\lfloor 3 \rfloor = 3,\) and \(\lfloor \frac{9}{2} \rfloor = 4.\) Compute \[ \begin{gathered} \lfloor \sqrt{1} \rfloor + \lfloor \sqrt{2} \rfloor + \lfloor \sqrt{3} \rfloor \\ {}+ \cdots + \lfloor \sqrt{16} \rfloor. \end{gathered} \]
